commerce_agreement_explanation: RentADriver arranges physical parcel pickup and delivery by couriers. Users obtain a delivery quote and pay for a physical delivery from their prepaid RentADriver wallet. The card-deposit tool links to Stripe Checkout for wallet funding; the user completes payment outside ChatGPT. The plugin does not sell digital content, software subscriptions or subscription upgrades.
description: Check delivery coverage, request a price, book package deliveries and track their progress with RentADriver. Delivery coverage currently includes service areas in the United Kingdom, United States and Moldova; check coverage for each pickup and drop-off. Booking requires a connected RentADriver account and sufficient prepaid wallet balance. Prices and driver availability come from the service; coverage does not guarantee an available driver or pickup time.

screenshots.user_prompt: Quote a small parcel from London Waterloo station to London Bridge station. Do not book it.
Show my active deliveries and their latest tracking status.

subtitle: Quote, book and track parcels

test_cases.expected_output: Return current service areas and coverage for London Waterloo. Explain that coverage does not guarantee a driver or pickup time. Verified in sandbox; a transient coverage error passed on retry.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which cities does RentADriver cover, and is London Waterloo station covered?

test_cases.expected_output: Return current price, currency and quote identifier for the supplied public stations, without booking. Do not invent driver availability or promise a pickup time.
test_cases.user_prompt: Quote a small parcel from London Waterloo station to London Bridge station. Do not book it.

test_cases.expected_output: Return only the connected sandbox account’s balances in each workspace currency. Do not create a deposit or transfer. Workspace listing passed on sequential retry.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my RentADriver account status and country wallet balances.

test_cases.expected_output: Return the sandbox delivery list and actual status, tracking and proof for RD-XXXXXX (completed/paid at verification). It has simulated photo proof. If unavailable, select a returned sandbox fixture.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my sandbox deliveries, then show the status, tracking and proof for RD-XXXXXX. If unavailable, use a sandbox delivery from the returned list.

test_cases.expected_output: Return dry_run=true for the London quote with dryRun=true and fund=false. Do not create a booking or reserve funds. ChatGPT verification found the delivery count and GB wallet balance unchanged.
test_cases.user_prompt: Preview a small parcel delivery from London Waterloo station to London Bridge station without placing an order.

test_credentials: Connect with OAuth using a sandbox account; see README

check_coverage.destructive_justification: Only checks coverage; no delivery, charge, cancellation or other irreversible action.
check_coverage.open_world_justification: May geocode an arbitrary address using an external mapping provider.
check_coverage.read_only_justification: Reads coverage for the supplied location without booking or changing account data.

list_service_areas.destructive_justification: Does not change service areas, bookings or account data.
list_service_areas.open_world_justification: Returns the bounded RentADriver service-area catalogue; no arbitrary external destination.
list_service_areas.read_only_justification: Reads the configured service-area catalogue only.

get_quote.destructive_justification: Adds an expiring quote only; it does not dispatch a driver, spend funds or replace a booking.
get_quote.open_world_justification: Resolves supplied addresses and route estimates using external mapping services.
get_quote.read_only_justification: Persists a time-limited quote record; it does not book a delivery or hold funds.

list_intercity_lanes.destructive_justification: Does not alter routes, reserve capacity or create a delivery.
list_intercity_lanes.open_world_justification: Queries RentADriver’s fixed lane catalogue rather than arbitrary external resources.
list_intercity_lanes.read_only_justification: Reads configured intercity lanes, schedules and sample prices.

get_intercity_quote.destructive_justification: Only adds an expiring quote; no booking, payment or dispatch occurs.
get_intercity_quote.open_world_justification: May geocode arbitrary addresses and request route estimates from external mapping services.
get_intercity_quote.read_only_justification: Creates a persisted intercity quote record; no delivery is booked.

get_platform_stats.destructive_justification: Does not modify individual records or operational state.
get_platform_stats.open_world_justification: Returns a bounded aggregate of RentADriver’s own operational records.
get_platform_stats.read_only_justification: Reads aggregate counts of drivers, deliveries and connected agents.

list_country_workspaces.destructive_justification: Does not enable workspaces, change balances or transfer money.
list_country_workspaces.open_world_justification: Access is limited to the connected account’s workspaces and configured country list.
list_country_workspaces.read_only_justification: Reads the authenticated account’s country workspaces and balances.

enable_country_workspace.destructive_justification: Adds a workspace with zero balance; existing balances remain unchanged.
enable_country_workspace.open_world_justification: Operates only within the authenticated RentADriver account and supported countries.
enable_country_workspace.read_only_justification: Creates an additional country workspace for the authenticated account.

signup.destructive_justification: Adds account records; does not overwrite an existing account or charge a wallet.
signup.open_world_justification: Creates records within RentADriver’s account service, with a fixed supported-country set.
signup.read_only_justification: Creates a new account and its initial API key.

check_account_status.destructive_justification: Does not change permissions, limits, credentials or money.
check_account_status.open_world_justification: Uses only the account associated with the current authentication credential.
check_account_status.read_only_justification: Reads authentication status, account capabilities, balance and spending limits.

get_wallet_balance.destructive_justification: Does not debit, credit or move wallet funds.
get_wallet_balance.open_world_justification: Limited to a workspace owned by the authenticated account.
get_wallet_balance.read_only_justification: Reads the selected workspace wallet balance and ledger.

create_wallet_deposit.destructive_justification: Creating the checkout session does not charge a card; the user must separately complete payment.
create_wallet_deposit.open_world_justification: Contacts Stripe and returns an external hosted checkout URL.
create_wallet_deposit.read_only_justification: Creates a Stripe Checkout session for a requested wallet top-up.

create_x402_deposit.destructive_justification: This tool cannot sign or submit a payment; funding requires a separate signed REST request outside this tool.
create_x402_deposit.open_world_justification: Returns USDC/Base payment requirements for use with an external x402 client.
create_x402_deposit.read_only_justification: Calls the funding endpoint to obtain payment requirements for the requested amount.

set_spending_controls.destructive_justification: Overwrites controls and can remove limits that protect existing wallet funds.
set_spending_controls.open_world_justification: Only changes controls on the authenticated account’s selected workspace.
set_spending_controls.read_only_justification: Updates the workspace’s per-delivery and daily spending limits.

list_api_keys.destructive_justification: Does not create, revoke or disclose full existing API keys.
list_api_keys.open_world_justification: Limited to keys belonging to the authenticated RentADriver account.
list_api_keys.read_only_justification: Reads key metadata such as prefix, last use and revocation state; not full keys.

create_api_key.destructive_justification: Adds a credential without revoking or replacing existing keys; the new key does grant account access.
create_api_key.open_world_justification: Creates a key only for the authenticated RentADriver account.
create_api_key.read_only_justification: Creates an additional credential and returns the new key once.

revoke_api_key.destructive_justification: Permanently deactivates the selected key; dependent clients lose access.
revoke_api_key.open_world_justification: Limited to API keys belonging to the authenticated account.
revoke_api_key.read_only_justification: Changes an existing API key to revoked.

create_delivery.destructive_justification: A funded booking reserves money and can initiate real-world delivery obligations and cancellation fees.
create_delivery.open_world_justification: Can dispatch real drivers to user-specified pickup and drop-off locations.
create_delivery.read_only_justification: Creates a booking and can reserve wallet funds and begin dispatch; dryRun is optional.

create_store_pickup.destructive_justification: Can hold funds and dispatch a driver to collect an order; cancellation may incur fees.
create_store_pickup.open_world_justification: Coordinates real drivers, stores and recipient locations supplied by the user.
create_store_pickup.read_only_justification: Creates and funds a pickup-and-delivery booking unless dryRun is requested.

create_batch.destructive_justification: Can commit multiple wallet holds and real-world bookings in a single call.
create_batch.open_world_justification: May dispatch real drivers for multiple user-specified delivery routes.
create_batch.read_only_justification: Submits up to 25 delivery creation requests, each potentially funded.

fund_delivery.destructive_justification: Commits wallet funds and can trigger driver assignment and cancellation liability.
fund_delivery.open_world_justification: Initiates the driver-dispatch workflow outside the requesting account.
fund_delivery.read_only_justification: Reserves wallet funds for an existing delivery and starts dispatch when eligible.

get_delivery.destructive_justification: Does not modify the booking, contact details, money or dispatch state.
get_delivery.open_world_justification: Limited to deliveries accessible through the authenticated account.
get_delivery.read_only_justification: Reads one delivery and its associated tracking details.

list_deliveries.destructive_justification: Does not create, cancel or change any delivery.
list_deliveries.open_world_justification: Results are scoped to the authenticated RentADriver account.
list_deliveries.read_only_justification: Reads delivery records matching the supplied filters.

create_recipient_code.destructive_justification: Replacing the code immediately invalidates the previous code and changes recipient access.
create_recipient_code.open_world_justification: Limited to a stop on a delivery accessible to the authenticated account.
create_recipient_code.read_only_justification: Generates or replaces the handover code for a delivery stop.

track_delivery.destructive_justification: Does not move the driver, change the route or update delivery state.
track_delivery.open_world_justification: Limited to one authorized delivery and its assigned driver.
track_delivery.read_only_justification: Reads the current delivery status, ETA and assigned driver position.

get_delivery_events.destructive_justification: Does not add, delete or edit events.
get_delivery_events.open_world_justification: Limited to the selected delivery accessible to the authenticated account.
get_delivery_events.read_only_justification: Reads the existing delivery event timeline.

update_delivery.destructive_justification: Can overwrite delivery instructions or contact details and alter an in-progress handover.
update_delivery.open_world_justification: Only updates an existing delivery accessible to the connected account.
update_delivery.read_only_justification: Replaces permitted instructions, contact details, contingency rules or metadata.

cancel_delivery.destructive_justification: Stops the booking and can incur a cancellation fee after driver assignment.
cancel_delivery.open_world_justification: Operates on one existing delivery within the authenticated account.
cancel_delivery.read_only_justification: Changes the delivery’s state to cancelled when allowed.

create_return.destructive_justification: Creates a delivery obligation that can lead to funding, dispatch and cancellation fees.
create_return.open_world_justification: Can arrange a real-world return journey involving a driver and recipient.
create_return.read_only_justification: Creates a new reverse delivery from the selected original delivery.

send_message_to_driver.destructive_justification: The driver can receive and read the message immediately; sending cannot be reliably undone.
send_message_to_driver.open_world_justification: Communicates with a driver outside the requesting customer account.
send_message_to_driver.read_only_justification: Adds a message and sends it to the assigned driver through push and in-app channels.

get_delivery_messages.destructive_justification: Does not send, edit or delete messages.
get_delivery_messages.open_world_justification: Limited to the authenticated account’s delivery conversation.
get_delivery_messages.read_only_justification: Reads existing messages for one delivery.

get_proof_of_delivery.destructive_justification: Does not change or delete proof, confirm delivery or release payment.
get_proof_of_delivery.open_world_justification: Evidence is restricted to a delivery accessible through the authenticated account.
get_proof_of_delivery.read_only_justification: Reads delivery proof and generates time-limited access URLs for stored evidence.

confirm_delivery.destructive_justification: Releases held funds and finalizes settlement; it is not a read-only acknowledgement.
confirm_delivery.open_world_justification: Affects the assigned driver’s settlement as well as the customer booking.
confirm_delivery.read_only_justification: Confirms receipt and releases the held delivery payment to the driver.

open_dispute.destructive_justification: Changes settlement handling and can prevent release of held funds.
open_dispute.open_world_justification: Limited to an authorized delivery and RentADriver’s internal dispute workflow.
open_dispute.read_only_justification: Creates a dispute and keeps delivery funds held for operations review.

tip_driver.destructive_justification: Spends wallet funds; retries must reuse the idempotency key to avoid additional tips.
tip_driver.open_world_justification: Benefits the assigned driver, a party outside the requesting customer account.
tip_driver.read_only_justification: Debits the customer wallet and credits a tip for the delivery’s driver.

rate_driver.destructive_justification: Can replace a rating and affect the driver’s reputation.
rate_driver.open_world_justification: Limited to the assigned driver on an authorized completed delivery.
rate_driver.read_only_justification: Writes the rating and optional comment for a completed delivery.

list_shopify_orders.destructive_justification: Does not book, fulfill, cancel or modify a store order.
list_shopify_orders.open_world_justification: Limited to shops and orders connected to the authenticated RentADriver account.
list_shopify_orders.read_only_justification: Reads orders and booking status already associated with connected Shopify shops.

book_shopify_order.destructive_justification: Can reserve funds, dispatch a courier and change the order’s fulfillment state.
book_shopify_order.open_world_justification: Interacts with Shopify, the store, recipient and dispatched driver.
book_shopify_order.read_only_justification: Books a delivery for a connected Shopify order and can update fulfillment.

list_store_orders.destructive_justification: Does not create deliveries or change store orders.
list_store_orders.open_world_justification: Limited to stores connected to the authenticated account.
list_store_orders.read_only_justification: Reads order and booking records for the specified connected commerce platform.

book_store_order.destructive_justification: Can spend reserved wallet funds, dispatch a courier and mark an order shipped or fulfilled.
book_store_order.open_world_justification: Interacts with the external commerce platform, store, recipient and driver.
book_store_order.read_only_justification: Creates a delivery for a connected store order and can update shipment status.

register_webhook.destructive_justification: Adds a subscription rather than deleting existing data; it enables future event disclosure to that URL.
register_webhook.open_world_justification: Registers a user-supplied external URL that will receive delivery event requests.
register_webhook.read_only_justification: Creates a webhook subscription and its signing secret.

list_webhooks.destructive_justification: Does not register, delete or send a webhook.
list_webhooks.open_world_justification: Limited to webhooks belonging to the authenticated account.
list_webhooks.read_only_justification: Reads the account’s existing webhook subscriptions.

delete_webhook.destructive_justification: Stops future and queued deliveries to that webhook; missed events may not be recoverable.
delete_webhook.open_world_justification: Limited to webhook records belonging to the authenticated account.
